SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.zh: 義大利北部倫巴第大區報告歐洲首例H9N2流感人類感染病例,病患來自非歐洲國家且於該地感染,感染前健康狀況不佳,住院治療中。另已啟動專家小組,以利與相關國際機構進行協調,並持續監控中。 全球約90%報告H9N2病例報告自中國,另越南、印度、埃及、塞內加爾及迦納也曾報告過病例,該病毒主要透過直接接觸受感染之家禽或受污染環境傳播,人類感染症狀輕微,尚未有人際間傳播案例。
SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.en: Lombardy Region in northern Italy has reported Europe's first human H9N2 influenza infection. The patient came from a non-European country and was infected there; the patient was in poor health before infection and is being treated in hospital. Authorities have also activated an expert group to coordinate with relevant international agencies, and monitoring continues. Around 90% of H9N2 cases reported globally have come from China; Viet Nam, India, Egypt, Senegal and Ghana have also reported cases. The virus is transmitted mainly through direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments; human infections have mild symptoms, and no human-to-human transmission has been reported.

gSKbfuqVEVcdFoCrmU9GLA.zh: 全球自今年9/5解除PHEIC截至11/24(除非洲現有疫區外),累計報告43例Ib型病例(歐洲27例、東南亞5例、美洲4例、西太平洋3例、東地中海/非洲各2例),其中22例為MSM族群;4區署(美洲/歐洲/東南亞/西太平洋)報告24例本土病例,其餘為旅遊相關或其繼發病例。 荷蘭新增3例病例,自10/17報告首例截至11/24已累計9例Ib型病例,其中8例為MSM,6例有共同俱樂部之群聚事件;西班牙自9月截至11/24累計報告6例Ib病例,另新增2例報告為疑I型分支,且無相關旅遊史之病例;黎巴嫩及埃及於今年9-10月分別報告3例及1例病例,分支皆未明。
gSKbfuqVEVcdFoCrmU9GLA.en: Since the PHEIC was lifted on 5 September this year, as of 24 November (excluding existing outbreak areas in Africa), 43 clade Ib cases have been reported cumulatively: 27 in Europe, 5 in South-East Asia, 4 in the Americas, 3 in the Western Pacific, and 2 each in the Eastern Mediterranean and Africa. Of these, 22 were among MSM. Four regions (the Americas, Europe, South-East Asia and the Western Pacific) reported 24 local cases; the rest were travel-related or secondary cases. The Netherlands reported 3 new cases. Since its first case on 17 October, the Netherlands had recorded 9 clade Ib cases by 24 November, 8 of them among MSM, and 6 of these were linked to a shared club cluster. Spain reported 6 clade Ib cases cumulatively from September to 24 November, and 2 further newly reported cases were suspected clade I cases without relevant travel history. Lebanon and Egypt reported 3 and 1 cases respectively in September and October this year; clade is unknown.
